title: Analytic Solutions of the Double Diffusive Convection Equation System
content:
We investigate the partial differential equation system which describes the double-diffusion convection phenomena with the reduction formalism.
Double-diffusion means when two scalar quantities with different diffusivities, such as heat and solute concentration, contribute
to density gradients within a fluid under the influence of gravity. 
The time-dependent self-similar trial function is applied and analytic results are presented and analyzed in details.
